findings.title: No S1 test for an agent folder the repo ignores; the handoff claims one
findings.detail:
implement#2's handoff says: New S1 test "AC1: an agent folder the repo ignores → the link is recreated and not staged, the rest staged". The file has only two AC1 tests (grep 'ignores' finds nothing), and commit 2fedc55f8 changed the test file by one line (the import). The contract case in packages/adapters/test/contract/git.ts proves GitPort.ignored, but nothing at S1 proves that upgrade filters ignored links before git add (packages/cli/src/commands/upgrade.ts:194-195), which is exactly review#1's blocking bug. Reverting those two lines leaves every test green.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add the test: init, add .claude/ to .gitignore and untrack it, commit; remove a link and drift a skill; norn upgrade → exit 0, link is a symlink again, porcelain shows the staged skill (and the team file when the version moves), nothing under .claude/.

findings.title: Two blank lines in the markdown when nothing moved and no config changed
findings.detail:
out starts [title, '', summary, ''] and the skills/version lines push '' again, so a skills-only upgrade prints an empty line twice after the summary (seen by hand).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Push the trailing '' only before a section that does not start with one, or join sections instead.
